pages.text: The c0de disk looks like an old floppy disk. It carries one program.$(br2)To copy a program onto the disk, right-click the PROGRAM block with it. This also works while the program runs.

To build the program of a disk, right-click the floor at the start of an empty sheet (x=5, line 0). In survival mode, the blocks come from your inventory.$(br2)Recipe: a data item, an iron ingot and black dye, in any shape.
